comments.author: Steward
comments.body:
Put it this way - if you never feed your aide, they will end up with about 2/3 the points compared to feeding them.....but you have to feed them LOTS....

For whatever attribute you are trying to raise, feed them the Aide Food for that attribute, but KEEP feeding them until they stop talking. (Each time you feed them, they say something, for about 20-25 food....)

At their next level up, they will have a higher chance to raise that point, even if you never used them in that type of job.

After they level up, feed them again for the next level!

As you can see, this can get REALLY expensive..... I brought one of my aides up to about 30/20/20 and they had DOUBLE the points of my other aide which was 40.30.25...but it probably cost me 200mil or more.

comments.author: condi
comments.body: when you use aide food, does it go to both aides? only my first aide seem to talk.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Yes, both aides should be getting "fed" regardless of one doing the talking. In fact, when you have three or more aides, I've found it can be helpful to feed them all at once in your quarters -- you tend to go through less aide food that way.

The exception to this rule is if you've previously fed an aide one kind of food (let's say, Storekeeper), and they leveled without getting a Storekeeper trait point. Until the aide gets a Storekeeper point, any further Storekeeper aide food will be wasted on them. Hope that helps (and makes sense).
